name: Myr Battlesphere
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create four 1/1 colorless Myr artifact creature tokens.
Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap X untapped Myr you control. If you do, this creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn and deals X damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, create four 1/1 colorless Myr artifact creature tokens.
Whenever this creature attacks, you may tap X untapped Myr you control. If you do, this creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn and deals X damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.

needs.what: a 1/1 colorless Myr artifact creature token (e.g. id myr_1_1_c)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list with no Myr; the nearest colorless 1/1 artifact creature tokens (servo_1_1_c, gnome_1_1_c, soldier_1_1_c) have the wrong creature type, which matters because the card's own attack trigger counts untapped Myr

needs.what: an optional resolution-time choice to tap any number X of untapped permanents matching a selector (untapped Myr you control), binding X so later effects can read it, then damage dealt by the source to the player or planeswalker it is attacking
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `may` carries `x` and `pay` but nothing documents paying by tapping a chosen number of permanents; `tap_permanents` exists only as an activated-ability cost with a fixed count, not on a triggered ability; and `damage` has no documented player/object spec for 'the player or planeswalker this creature is attacking' (`defending` is a trigger key, not a damage recipient)
